policy.verified_false_positive: Requires source-adjudicated non-secret identity; unexplained/unmapped finding stays pending review.
policy.occurrences: One per introduced or changed credential placement, not per scan snapshot; pure rename creates none.
policy.unique_secrets: One per owner-approved source secret group.
policy.informative: Report separately; excluded from primary recall.
policy.identity_validation: Validate value or typed source-attributed representation; do not award path-only/substring-only matches by default.
normalization: PEM: allow only terminal-newline variation for a validated complete private-key block.
JetBrains: encoded FTP attribute or properly attributed decoded password.
FileZilla: correctly attributed Base64 Pass fields.
MongoDB URI: validate embedded password, not merely URI hash.
AWS: nonstandard synthetic formats and inverted labels retained.
policy.informative_lineage: LH-0170 is informative rename-lineage metadata, with no new introduction occurrence.
policy.exact_value_negatives: PNM-001, PNM-002 and PNJ-001 are scoped to identity.secret_sha256; they do not exempt any other token on the same source line.
